title: Healthcare's Digital Pulse: IGEL Appoints James Millington as EMEA Field CTO
summary: IGEL has announced the appointment of James Millington as its new Field CTO for Healthcare in EMEA, signaling a significant push to deepen its expertise and support within the region's rapidly digitizing healthcare sector. This strategic move aims to fortify IGEL's leadership and enhance its Adaptive Secure Endpoint Platform's adoption among healthcare providers and partners facing evolving challenges.
content:
LONDON — In a move underscoring its deepening commitment to the digital transformation of healthcare, global software giant IGEL has announced the appointment of James Millington as its new Field CTO for Healthcare across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). This strategic hire, revealed today from IGEL's London hub, is set to significantly bolster the company’s leadership and support capabilities within the region’s critical healthcare sector.

The healthcare landscape in EMEA is undergoing an unprecedented digital shift, grappling with everything from escalating cybersecurity threats to the imperative for seamless, secure remote access for clinicians. IGEL's Adaptive Secure Endpoint Platform, designed to simplify and secure endpoint management, is increasingly vital for institutions striving to deliver efficient patient care in this complex environment. Millington’s appointment reflects IGEL’s proactive stance in addressing these unique challenges.

Millington brings a wealth of experience to the role, boasting a distinguished career spanning several decades at the intersection of technology and healthcare. His expertise lies in navigating the intricate regulatory frameworks and operational demands that characterize the industry, making him an ideal strategist to guide IGEL’s engagement with hospitals, clinics, and health systems. He will be instrumental in translating IGEL’s innovative solutions into tangible benefits for healthcare providers, ensuring their digital infrastructure is robust, secure, and user-friendly.

As Field CTO, Millington will be at the forefront, engaging directly with customers and partners to understand their evolving needs and evangelize IGEL's vision for secure, flexible healthcare endpoints. His leadership is expected to drive deeper collaboration, accelerate solution adoption, and solidify IGEL's position as a trusted advisor in EMEA’s healthcare technology market. This strategic reinforcement is poised to empower more healthcare organizations to leverage modern digital workspaces, ultimately enhancing patient data security and clinician productivity.
keyTakeaways: IGEL appointed James Millington as Field CTO for Healthcare in EMEA to strengthen its regional leadership and support.
Millington brings extensive experience in healthcare technology to help address the sector's unique digital transformation and security challenges.
This strategic move aims to accelerate the adoption of IGEL's Adaptive Secure Endpoint Platform and deepen engagement with healthcare providers and partners across EMEA.
author: Staff Writer
